title: Enterprise Account Executive, Opticom
descriptionHtml:
About Miovision:

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

  • All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

  • One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

  • Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

  • Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

  • Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

Miovision’s Opticom product has been providing best-in-class priority control solutions for over 58 years. A testament to Opticom’s quality and durability is the continuing growth in the customer base, now at over 180,000 intersections and vehicles with over 5,000 customers worldwide. Our success is based on working with communities to provide the best emergency vehicle preemption and transit signal priority systems.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will operate as a critical, strategic business partner to identify, develop, and close high-value business opportunities within California. You will act as the "General Manager" of your target accounts, maintaining existing customer relationships and growing major net-new business.

This role requires orchestrating cross-functional internal teams while successfully navigating, influencing, and negotiating with executive buying committees and distribution networks to drive large-scale adoption of Miovision’s Opticom platform and integrated solutions.

Your mission is to ensure Miovision always gets the green light to help cities improve the safety, reliability, and efficiency of their emergency and transit vehicles, optimize traffic flow, reduce congestion and enhance smart mobility.

Location: You must be located in California to be considered for this position.

Objectives and Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account and Territory Penetration: Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas by developing and executing comprehensive territory business plans, including market assumptions, forecasting, risks, and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead complex, multi-layered enterprise sales cycles involving significant ambiguity, designing highly customized solutions, pricing models, and non-standard contract structures to secure large wins.

  • Playbook and Action Plan Innovation: Prepare innovative sales action plans and targeted strategies to penetrate complex accounts rather than relying strictly on legacy corporate playbooks.

  • C-Suite and Executive Influence: Navigate, influence, and negotiate with executive-level buying committees, senior-level customers, and large public audiences.

  • Internal Resource Orchestration: Build strong, cross-functional alliances internally with Solution Engineering, Legal, Operations, and Customer Success to effectively allocate resources and push through high-stakes enterprise deals.

  • Ecosystem and Channel Management: Develop and maintain high-impact partnerships with strategic distribution partners, engineering consultants, and key stakeholders in the territory.

  • Account Lifecycle Ambassador: Act as an ambassador to enterprise accounts, continuously tracking initial sale success, managing emerging client needs, and maintaining strong, long-term customer satisfaction.

  • Pipeline and Market Discipline: Maintain disciplined pipeline management and a meticulous customer database within Salesforce to provide highly accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasting to leadership.

  • Market Intelligence Feedback: Stay highly current on market challenges, the competitive landscape, and technology evolution to effectively position Miovision's value proposition and feed critical intelligence back to the business.

  • Mentorship: Frequently advise revenue leadership on complex commercial challenges and actively help raise the overall skill level and execution of the broader sales organization.

  • Travel: Represent Miovision in the field (up to 40%).

Ideal Profile:

  • Enterprise Consultative Selling: Fully seasoned understanding of complex enterprise solution-selling methodologies, long-cycle B2B/B2G (Government) procurement, and account-based strategy.

  • Domain Expertise: Understanding of the public safety sector, traffic/transportation or proven experience selling technology to the first responder market (specifically to Fire, EMS, and police).

  • Commercial and Legal Negotiation: Highly skilled in navigating complex pricing models, non-standard deal specifics, and commercial contract negotiations.

  • Matrix Stakeholder Management: Skilled at coordinating massive, matrixed buying units (e.g., public safety vs. transit vs. engineering vs. procurement) where issues are complicated, politically sensitive, and require advanced tactical navigation.

  • Strategic Resource Orchestration: Demonstrated ability to lead an internal matrixed teams (Product, Engineering, Executive Sponsors, Legal) to align against a shared account target.

  • Executive Communication Mastery: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with a proven room-command to articulate abstract value propositions to senior public and private stakeholders.

  • CRM and Database Discipline: Advanced proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce) for programmatic pipeline building, territory documentation, and structured forecasting.

  • High Autonomy & Maturity: Demonstrated self-sufficiency and quick learning capacity with the ability to absorb complex operational instructions rapidly and execute with minimal supervision.

  • Travel: Represent Miovision in the field (up to 40% travel required and must be able to travel freely between the USA and Canada).

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

  • Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

  • Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

  • Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
